=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:299 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The missing-marker check uses `grep -qF "${MARKER_PREFIX}gen="` which is a plain substring match. A non-triage source issue whose body mentions the literal text `check-failure-triage:gen=` followed by non-digits (for example in documentation, a code example, or a malformed marker) will pass the grep test, causing the code to skip the new elif branch and fall into the else branch at line 309, which exits 1 with `parent_generation_missing_or_malformed`.
  WHY: The sed at line 293 extracts PGEN only when followed by digits (`[0-9]\{1,\}`), so a body containing `check-failure-triage:gen=abc` leaves PGEN empty. The first branch at line 295 fails (empty PGEN doesn't match `^[0-9]+$`). The elif at line 299 succeeds because grep finds the substring, so the negation is false and the elif body is skipped. The else branch exits 1. A non-triage issue mentioning the marker text in prose is incorrectly treated as having a malformed marker rather than starting a new lineage at generation 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
